name: Quel Visual Novel est fait pour moi ?
source:
"Which Visual Novel is made for me ?" is a guide designed to help different audiences find visual novel that suit their tastes. This is not a story but rather a non-exhaustive inventory listing the titles that currently exist in French.

Using different criteria (importance of romance, support, genre, etc.), the fictional character of Mirei will advise you by tapping into her catalog, which currently contains about fifty titles. It is not excluded that it will be updated in the future, depending on the success of the initiative!

Whether you're a beginner looking for their first VN or simply curious, Mirei will do her best to help you find what you need!
translation:
“哪部视觉小说是为我制作的？”是一本旨在帮助不同受众找到适合他们口味的视觉小说的指南。这不是一个故事，而是一个非详尽的清单，列出了当前法语版本的书籍。

使用不同的标准（浪漫、支持、类型等的重要性），虚构角色Mirei将通过挖掘她的目录（目前包含大约50个标题）为你提供建议。不排除以后会更新，就看倡议成功了！

无论你是正在寻找第一个VN的初学者还是只是好奇，Mirei都会尽力帮助你找到你需要的东西！
